name: Caring
overview: Scripture calls believers to express genuine love and care for others, reflecting the sacrificial love Christ demonstrated by laying down His life for His friends. This care extends to all relationships, including honoring and supporting parents and the elderly, as loving one’s neighbor as oneself fulfills God's law. The teaching to treat others as we would want to be treated underscores the practical outworking of this care, rooted in the example of God’s love in giving His Son for our salvation.
